text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Unicorn Stakes. Due to the 
biting incident, Shinko Windy is the 
center of attention, with the crowd 
mocking her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She felt like biting the spectators, but 
remembered her promise and held back. She 
decided to channel all that frustration 
into the race instead.
